subject: Audit/access trail export options & residency — Q&A for FinWare
messages:
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@finware.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finware.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit trails — export formats / residency / deletion workflow

Hi Rachel / Ben,

We're preparing for an upcoming regulator request and need to confirm how Redwood handles audit/access logs for our account. Specific questions below — can you confirm by EOD Monday?

1) Residency: if we require US-only residency for audit logs, can exports be generated from a US region only (no EU transit)?
2) Retention & export window: what's the maximum retention you support on Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (on-prem)?
3) Export formats & filters: can we export per-tenant, per-API-key, and include request/response metadata? Preferred formats are NDJSON or Parquet.
4) Deletion: when we request deletion, what's the workflow and SLA (e.g., soft delete window, hard purge timing, attestations)?
5) Bulk exports for eDiscovery: are there scheduled export jobs or S3 delivery options?

We also might need a signed attestation that exports were generated in-region if requested by the regulator.

Thanks — Jorge
Jorge Alvarez
Head of InfoSec, FinWare
jorge.alvarez@finware.com
[Attachment: regulator-scope.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@finware.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit trails — export formats / residency / deletion workflow

Hi Jorge — thanks for the clear list. Below are concise answers and next steps; attaching a one-page quicksheet with export options.

Quick answers (high level):
- Residency: yes — we support region-restricted audit log storage on Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API customers we can scope audit log exports to a specific region (US) and provide an in-region export job; however, telemetry may transiently route through control-plane endpoints for orchestration (we provide an attestation for any in-region export).
- Retention: Hosted default 90 days (configurable up to 12 months on request); Dedicated reserved pools can retain logs for customer-controlled windows (commonly 1–3 years) — Private/on-prem retention is customer-controlled and unlimited subject to storage.
- Export formats/filters: exports support NDJSON, CSV, and Parquet. Filters: tenant_id, api_key, model_id, time-range, route. Exports include request metadata, headers, timestamps and limited response metadata (we exclude full user prompt content unless customer enables full-recording).
- Deletion workflow: we have a two-step delete: soft-delete (30 days by default) then hard purge. For Hosted customers we can shorten the soft-delete window to 0 for faster purges with an approval/authorization flow. We provide deletion attestations and a signed confirmation for compliance requests.
- Bulk eDiscovery: scheduled exports (daily/weekly) to a customer-provided S3 bucket, direct BigQuery writes, or syslog/ELK drains for near-real-time streaming. Exports can be encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS).

Next steps: I attached the quicksheet and a template MRAP doc if you want us to fill the attestation fields. If you need the export to be executed from the US region with a signed attestation, say so and we'll open an internal ticket (takes ~3 business days to schedule).

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Account Security Lead, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
[Attachment: audit-export-quicksheet.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@finware.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit trails — export formats / residency / deletion workflow

Jorge — couple practical notes from a commercial/ops perspective:

- If you stay on Hosted and need >12 months retention with in-region guarantees, we'll need a short addendum (pricing varies based on retention and export frequency).
- Dedicated: retention is part of the Dedicated config. We can set up an S3 export with lifecycle rules you control; Redwood will not delete from your bucket.
- Private/on-prem: you control retention and deletion — Redwood provides the export agents/ops runbook.
- SLA & timing: for ad-hoc exports we typically deliver within 48–72 hours once the ticket is approved. Scheduled exports are set up in the console and delivered within the configured cadence.

If you confirm: (1) target retention period, (2) preferred export destination (S3 / BigQuery / syslog), and (3) whether you want a signed attestation generated by Redwood legal, I'll loop in Finance for the retention addendum and schedule the export task.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
